name: robots/navneet-nmk__hierarchical-meta-reinforcement-learning
title: MAML-RL TabularMDP-v0 (tabular MDP)
intro: MAML-RL TabularMDP-v0 (tabular MDP), adapted from navneet-nmk/hierarchical-meta-reinforcement-learning. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
